Unofficial app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian.

TickOff shows the open tasks of one Markdown file in your vault as a home-screen checklist. Ticking a task writes \"- [x]\" and today\'s done date into the file. A voice widget lets you dictate new tasks, which are added to the same file.

• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• TickOff only reads and writes the task files you choose: one in your vault folder, plus any file you pick for a widget.
• Speech recognition uses your phone's speech service. TickOff does not store audio.
• Only when you record tasks is the transcribed text sent to OpenAI or Anthropic (whichever you chose) with your own API key. Their privacy policy applies to that request.
• "Test API key" and "Load models" in Settings send only your key (and the model name) to that provider.
• Your settings and API key stay on this phone and are excluded from backups.
